capabilities: Capture notes as Keep-style cards with colors, labels, checklists, photos, voice memos and reminders
Store each note as a Markdown file with frontmatter in a configurable vault folder
Sync notes across devices via optional end-to-end encrypted cloud or any folder-sync tool
Save links with previews, clip web pages from Chrome, and extract text from photos (OCR)
Import existing notes from Google Takeout, Evernote and Apple Notes
extras: Freemium: the plugin is free, but JotDrop Cloud has a free 250 MB plan and a paid Plus tier (10 GB, more devices, full time-machine history). Everything except the web app works offline without an account; local notes are plain unencrypted Markdown. The README warns not to run two sync systems on the same notes folder and documents a Syncthing issue where an offline device can restore bulk-deleted notes. AI features send data to the user's chosen service (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, or local Ollama/LM Studio) under that service's terms.
intentEvidence: The free, open-source Google Keep alternative for Android, Obsidian, the web and Chrome
motivation: The author wanted to keep Google Keep's fast capture but own the notes: the README says JotDrop 'keeps the fast, friendly cards and gives you back the rest' and is inspired by 'the belief that your notes belong to you'.
problem: Obsidian has no Keep-style quick-capture card view with colors, labels, checklists and reminders, and services like Google Keep hold notes in a closed format on their servers.

relations.evidence: The free, open-source Google Keep alternative for Android, Obsidian, the web and Chrome
JotDrop for Joplin turns the notes you have there into a card board
Excalidraw drawings show as a picture on the card in Obsidian
Syncthing syncs your devices with each other, without any server in between

requires.name: JotDrop Cloud account for web app and cloud sync
Own API key for the Ask JotDrop AI assistant
Companion Android app and Chrome clipper for capture outside Obsidian

summary: Open-source Google Keep-style card board for quick-capture notes stored as plain Markdown files, with optional encrypted cloud sync, Android app and web clipper.
